status: registered before opening candidate target outcomes
motivation: The K16 multimodal field unary is strong, but the observed scribble/full-mask evidence should be an exact local constraint rather than only a prototype-bank constructor. Test whether exact-adjoint high-confidence rows can strengthen the unary without changing non-anchor rows.

control.purpose: Measure the K16 joint-signed prototype unary before any direct anchor overwrite.

candidate.non_anchor_policy: bitwise preserve the control field unary

gate.primary: candidate development-scene macro IoU exceeds the joint-signed control
gate.safety: neither scene regresses by more than 0.02 against the control
gate.expansion: only if both primary and safety pass, run all six heldout scenes unchanged
